Item 7.01    Regulation FD Disclosure.
On November 24, 2026, Public Service Company of New Mexico (“PNM”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of TXNM Energy, Inc., filed an application with the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission (“NMPRC”) for a general review of its retail electric rates and implementation of new rate structures (“2027 Rate Review”). The application requests an overall increase in retail revenue of $172.2 million, comprised of a $286.3 million increase in base rates and a $114.1 million decrease in revenues collected through PNM's Fuel and Purchased Power Adjustment Clause (“FPPAC”) and other rider mechanisms. The requested increase is based on a 9.9% return on equity and a 52.0% equity capitalization structure to be implemented October 1, 2027. 
A copy of PNM's 2027 Rate Review application is available at 
www.txnmenergy.com/investors/rates-and-filings/pnm-nmprc-filings
 and should be considered furnished in this item 7.01.
In accordance with General Instruction B.2 of Form 8-K, the information in this Item 7.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K shall not be deemed “filed” for the purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that Section, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall expressly set forth by specific references in such a filing. 
Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrants have duly caused this report to be signed on their behalf by the undersigned thereunto duly authorized.
